title: Matte Gray Towel Bar, 30-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Straight Bar, Que New Collection, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Matte Gray, towel bar, 30-inch wall mount straight bar for bathroom towel storage, made of solid brass with concealed screw mounting for a clean look, which provides a sophisticated neutral that complements concrete, stone, and other modern materials. Center-to-center 30 in; bar diameter 0.5 in; depth 33 in; height 3 in; supports up to 10 lb. Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware; uses #8 x 1 1/4" screws. Traditional-to-transitional styling with dramatic circular detailing; ideal for space-saving wall-mounted installation. Limited lifetime warranty.
